metadata.schema_version: v2.1 (Test50 8D rheology/thermal + sampled differentiated core + derived rho_sil)
metadata.description: Test52 10D: Test50 8D no-ocean Titan Andrade/Yao2014 parameter space (alpha, log10_zeta, log10_eta_{Ih,III,V,VI,sil}, Tb_K; bounds copied verbatim from test50_titan_noocean_andrade_8D.json) plus a sampled differentiated core (R_core_km, rho_core_kgm3) with rho_sil derived from mass conservation against the cached no-core hydrosphere. Uses the PPTest50 template (Planet.bodyname='Test50', Yao 2014 spherical Ih convection, clathrate cap, Kalousova HP convection, Arrhenius viscosity).
metadata.observables_rationale: Re_k2 = 0.608 +/- 0.048, Im_k2 = 0.135 +/- 0.035, and CMR2 = 0.343 +/- 0.001 (Radau-Darwin) are all taken directly from Petricca et al. (2025), Nature 648:558.
metadata.core_bounds_rationale: R_core_km in [0, 2000] spans the no-core limit up to a core radius below the full-body radius (R=2574.73 km, PPTest50.py), covering the differentiation range probed by the Phase 1 physical sanity anchors (no-core, 600 km, and 900 km cores at rock and metallic core densities). rho_core_kgm3 in [2591, 3600]: lower bound 2591 kg/m^3 is the Petricca et al. (2025) bulk-rock density for a differentiated silicate core; upper bound 3600 kg/m^3 is a user-adopted anhydrous-silicate bound (NOT paper-sourced) blessed 2026-07-08 pending a literature citation. rho_sil_kgm3 is not sampled directly; it is derived from mass conservation given the sampled core and the cached (core-independent) hydrosphere, then rejected (support rejection, like other guards) if outside [1800, 3500] kg/m^3.
metadata.density_inversion_guard_note: density_inversion_guard=true (new key, Phase 1) flags that samples with derived rho_sil_kgm3 > sampled rho_core_kgm3 (gravitationally unstable: mantle denser than core) must be rejected as an additional support constraint, analogous to reject_if_outside_bounds. This key is stored here at Phase 1 but is NOT YET CONSUMED by mcmc_runner.py's _derive_cmr2_via_mass_conservation -- InferenceConfig.from_json/derived_params tolerate and preserve unknown keys (verified against inference_core.py), so parsing this config is safe, but the actual rejection logic is Phase 2 scope only.
metadata.cmr2_offset_anchor_note: structure_derivation.compute_cmr2 evaluated on the reduced (core + derived-silicate + cached-hydrosphere) shell stack under-reports CMR2 by a stable +0.00095 relative to the PP-native CMR2mean for this template (pure hydrosphere radial-discretization error, verified core-independent and constant across the Tb grid and across sampled (R_core_km, rho_core_kgm3)). This Phase 1 cache build records the per-grid-point offset in the sidecar file titan_diff_noocean_structure_grid_offsets.json for Phase 2 to consume; the anchor correction (adding the recorded offset inside _derive_cmr2_via_mass_conservation before return) is NOT applied in Phase 1 -- _compute_model_cmr2 calls in this phase return the UNCORRECTED (reduced-stack) CMR2. Applying the correction is explicit Phase 2 scope (plans/test52-differentiated-titan-plan.md, decision 1).
metadata.phase_stability_rationale: phase_stability.enforce='no_ocean_Ih' with margin_K=0.1 copied verbatim from test50_titan_noocean_andrade_8D.json sampler_settings; Tb_K bounds [249.0, 250.965] copied verbatim from the same config (triple-point-depression band for the no-ocean Ih-clathrate structure).
